title: Classify two constant insertions after the stage-0 paired-star gates (no κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proof, for one pair of gaps. In the nine diagonal gates of PR #7027, insert constant matrices `R` and `S` immediately after stage-0 `I + x E_11` and stage-0 `I + x E_22`. The scalar `e` is central and `e^2 = 0`. The pure product `P` stays `product_j (I + x_j E_j)` for every such pair.

Over `F_2`, the coefficient of `e` equals `P` if and only if

- `R_ii + S_ii = 1` for every index,
- `R_ij = S_ij` on the 42 off-diagonal positions that miss coordinate 1,
- `R_ij = S_ij = 0` on the 14 off-diagonal positions that meet coordinate 1.

There are `2^50` such pairs. The set contains `(I, 0)`, `(0, I)`, and pairs with both matrices nonzero, including `R = I + E_02` and `S = E_02`. The same coefficient is never `I`: each diagonal entry is `0` or the corresponding diagonal entry of `P`, and those pure entries are not `1`.

This is an identity in `F_2[x, y, z][e]/(e^2)`, checked on every matrix unit in both gaps. It is not an enumeration of the `2^50` pairs and not a kappa improvement. The selected frontier stays 781451/250000000.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840` (canonical CrocSwap `main`, re-fetched before submission; it had not moved). Head: `f3af1384aeda8c75be58f09cb07da3941ba7aba3` on fork branch `cursor/two-gap-constant-insertion-1bb5`.

Task card: `joint-query-controller`, scope changed. The card asks whether a changed query demand removes real work. The actual question is the first open question of PR #7039, at the two gaps named in its first step.

Overlap was checked on 2026-11-10 against open upstream PR titles and bodies and against live `cursor/*` branches on `unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds`. The question is open in PR #7039. The valuation-1 word is PR #7027. The handoff pointer is https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19514178, and PR #7039 also points at https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5593#discussioncomment-19514176. No open PR and no fork branch solves these two gaps. `gh` GraphQL overlap refresh returned HTTP 403, so closed-PR body coverage is incomplete. The non-idempotent factor `N`, other gap pairs, and the g=13 and g=31 schedules were not taken.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-gap-constant-insertion
```

Both the ordinary run and the `-O` run print `PASS_TWO_GAP_CONSTANT_INSERTION`, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `completed`. Checks raise `SystemExit`, so optimized mode does not drop them. The direct command is `python3 -B research/two-gap-constant-insertion/verify.py`.

Checked facts: the nine-gate product matches the closed form of `P`; the two gap scales agree on 42 off-diagonal positions and differ by the factor `1 + x` on the 14 positions that meet coordinate 1; all 64 matrix units in each gap match that scale formula. Witnesses `(I, 0)`, `(0, I)` and `(I + E_02, E_02)` reproduce `P`. `(I, I)` does not. A blocked off-diagonal bit does not. No Lean, Docker, native, or selected-frontier replay was run.

## Credit

The paired-star contract, the operator `T`, and the pure target are from PR #5747 (Ali Romman), including PR #5673, PR #5631, and PR #5617. The valuation-1 triple is PR #7027, head `1ba2ac5adfe58fbe9dba34d50d4e5d30633ce3d0`. The one-insertion theorem and the question answered here are PR #7039, head `e4ddcd2fde8c46b7e528e8806ab72d9bf7690978`. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Independent human review and a proof-assistant proof are unclaimed. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

- For another pair of gaps in this same word, which constant pairs make the coefficient of `e` equal `P`? The first step is the gap after stage-0 `E_22` together with the gap after stage-1 `E_11`. Nothing external blocks that calculation. This package classifies only the adjacent pair named above.
- Can entries in `F_2[x]` of degree at most 1 produce further solutions in these same two gaps? The first step is `S_01 = 1` and `R_01 = 1 + x` with a legal constant diagonal. Nothing external blocks that entry. The constant count above stays as stated.
- For the non-idempotent factor `N` from PR #7027, does one constant matrix beside `I + x N` make the stage-0 coefficient of `e` equal `I`? The first step is to expand `(I + x N)(I + e R)`. Nothing external blocks that expansion.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The pinned selected record, rather than the decimal still printed in `current-priorities.md`, was the right frontier constant. Targeted issue search stood in for `find_overlap.py` because GraphQL returned HTTP 403. https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
